'''Teresa Lyn Head-Gordon''' (''née'' '''Teresa Lyn Gordon''') is an American chemist and the Chancellor's Professor of Chemistry, Bioengineering, and Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=berkeley>{{cite web|url=http://thglab.berkeley.edu|title=Teresa Head-Gordon Lab|website=thglab.berkeley.edu}}</ref> She is also a faculty scientist in the Chemical Sciences Division at the [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]] and a [[fellow]] of both the [[American Institute for Medical and Biological Engineering]] (AIMBE ) and the [[American Chemical Society]] (ACS).<ref name=fellow/>

== Early life and education ==
Head-Gordon was born in Akron, Ohio.<ref name=":0">{{cite journal | vauthors = Head-Gordon T, Hura G | title = Water structure from scattering experiments and simulation | journal = Chemical Reviews | volume = 102 | issue = 8 | pages = 2651–70 | date = 2002 | pmid = 12175263 | doi = 10.1021/cr0006831|url=https://escholarship.org/uc/item/9cb9x1qg }} {{free access}}</ref> She completed her bachelor's degree in chemistry at [[Case Western Reserve University]] in 1983.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://chemistry.berkeley.edu/faculty/chem/teresa-head-gordon|title=Teresa Head-Gordon {{!}} College of Chemistry|website=chemistry.berkeley.edu | access-date=2018-08-24}}</ref> She worked as a waitress for a year before starting a PhD in 1984, and in 1989 she earned her doctorate degree in [[Theoretical chemistry|Theoretical Chemistry]] from [[Carnegie Mellon University]] under the supervision of [[Charles L. Brooks III]].<ref name=tphd>{{cite thesis|degree=PhD|title=Macroscopic and microscopic simulation methods as applied to biological macromolecules|year=1989|last=Head-Gordon|first=Teresa Lyn|publisher=Carnegie Mellon University|id={{ProQuest|303689629}}}}</ref><ref name=tree/><ref name=":1" /><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Head-Gordon |first1=Teresa |last2=Head-Gordon |first2=Martin |last3=Frisch |first3=Michael J. |last4=Brooks |first4=Charles |last5=Pople |first5=John | name-list-style = vanc |date=2009-06-19 |title=A theoretical study of alanine dipeptide and analogs |journal=International Journal of Quantum Chemistry |volume=36 |issue=S16 |pages=311–322 |doi=10.1002/qua.560360725 }}</ref>

== Research and career ==
From 1990 to 1992 Head-Gordon worked as a postdoctoral member of technical staff at [[Bell Labs]], studying protein folding and the perturbation theories of water with [[Frank Stillinger]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=tree/> She joined [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]] in 1992, where she worked as a staff scientist until 2001.<ref name=":0" /> In 2001 Head-Gordon was awarded the IBM-SUR Award.<ref name=":1" /> That year she became a faculty member of Bioengineering at [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=":1" /> She was the 2005 Schlumberger Fellow at the [[University of Cambridge]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://calsolv.berkeley.edu/principal-investigators/|title=Principal Investigators|website=calsolv.berkeley.edu | access-date=2018-08-24}}</ref> In 2011 she became a member of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering department; in 2012 she joined the chemistry department at [[University of California, Berkeley]].,<ref name=":1" /> and joined the chemical sciences division as a faculty scientist at [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://commons.lbl.gov/display/csd/Teresa+L.+Head-Gordon|title=Teresa L. Head-Gordon - Chemical Sciences Division Chemical Sciences Division|website=commons.lbl.gov|access-date=25 August 2018}}</ref> In 2012 she was made the Chancellor's Professor at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=":1" /> She is a member of the Pitzer Center for Theoretical Chemistry.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.cchem.berkeley.edu/pitzer/members.htm|title=Pitzer Center for Theoretical Chemistry|website=www.cchem.berkeley.edu|access-date=25 August 2018}}</ref>

Head-Gordon develops theoretical models that are used in chemical physics and biophysics.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.cmu.edu/chemistry/news/2018/0816-ACS_Fellows.html |title=Four Chemistry Alumni Named American Chemical Society Fellows | work = Department of Chemistry - Mellon College of Science | publisher = Carnegie Mellon University   |access-date= 25 August 2018 }}</ref> The Head-Gordon group studies condensed phase systems ranging from biomolecular systems, molecular liquids, and complex interfaces.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://thglab.berkeley.edu/research/ |title= Teresa Head-Gordon Lab |website=thglab.berkeley.edu | access-date=25 August 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Demerdash|first1=Omar|last2=Wang|first2=Lee-Ping|last3=Head-Gordon|first3=Teresa | name-list-style = vanc |date=2017-11-23|title=Advanced models for water simulations |journal=Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews: Computational Molecular Science | volume=8|issue=1|article-number=e1355|doi=10.1002/wcms.1355 |url=https://escholarship.org/uc/item/2240z07q|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Welborn|first1=Valerie Vaissier|last2=Pestana|first2=Luis Ruiz|last3=Head-Gordon|first3=Teresa | name-list-style = vanc |date=2018|title=Computational optimization of electric fields for better catalysis design |journal=Nature Catalysis | volume=1|issue=9|pages=649–655|doi=10.1038/s41929-018-0109-2 |s2cid=69817927|url=https://escholarship.org/content/qt35b90345/qt35b90345.pdf?t=phvuvg}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | vauthors = Brookes, DH and Head-Gordon T | title = Experimental inferential structure determination of ensembles for intrinsically disordered proteins | journal = J. Am. Chem. Soc. | volume = 138 | issue = 13| pages = 4530–4538 | date = 2016 |doi = 10.1021/jacs.6b00351 | pmid = 26967199 | bibcode = 2016JAChS.138.4530B | s2cid = 207164128 | url = https://escholarship.org/uc/item/0rn6h689 }}</ref> Her group develops software packages for molecular simulations.<ref>{{cite journal | vauthors = Felberg LE, Brookes DH, Yap EH, Jurrus E, Baker NA, Head-Gordon T | title = PB-AM: An open-source, fully analytical linear poisson-boltzmann solver | journal = Journal of Computational Chemistry | volume = 38 | issue = 15 | pages = 1275–1282 | date = 2017 | pmid = 27804145 | pmc = 5403608 | doi = 10.1002/jcc.24528  }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | vauthors = Ponder JW, Wu C, Ren P, Pande VS, Chodera JD, Schnieders MJ, Haque I, Mobley DL, Lambrecht DS, DiStasio RA, Head-Gordon M, Clark GN, Johnson ME, Head-Gordon T | title = Current status of the AMOEBA polarizable force field | journal = The Journal of Physical Chemistry B | volume = 114 | issue = 8 | pages = 2549–64 | date = March 2010 | pmid = 20136072 | pmc = 2918242 | doi = 10.1021/jp910674d | bibcode = 2010JPCB..114.2549P }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal | vauthors = Jurrus E, Engel D, Star K, Monson K, Brandi J, Felberg LE, Brookes DH, Wilson L, Chen J, Liles K, Chun M, Li P, Dolinsky T, Konecny R, Koes D, Nielsen JE, Head-Gordon T, Geng W, Krasny R, Gunner M, Wei GW, Holst MJ, McCammon JA, Baker NA | title = Improvements to the APBS biomolecular solvation software suite | journal = Protein Science | volume = 27 | issue = 1| pages = 112–128 | date = 2018 | pmid = 28836357 | pmc = 5734301 | doi = 10.1002/pro.3280 }}</ref>

She is on the Board of Directors of the Molecular Sciences Software Institute.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://molssi.org/people/|title=Board of Directors – MolSSI|website=molssi.org | access-date=2018-08-24}}</ref>  She became co-director of CalSov in 2016.<ref name=":1" />  In 2016 she was elected a fellow of the [[American Institute for Medical and Biological Engineering]] for her contributions to the computational methodologies for macromolecular assemblies.<ref name=fellow>{{Cite web|url=https://aimbe.org/teresa-head-gordon-ph-d-to-be-inducted-into-medical-and-biological-engineering-elite/|title=Teresa Head-Gordon Teresa Head-Gordon, Ph.D. To be Inducted into Medical and Biological Engineering Elite - AIMBE|website=aimbe.org | access-date=25 August 2018}}</ref> In 2018 she was elected a [[Fellow]] of the [[American Chemical Society]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://chemistry.berkeley.edu/news/teresa-head-gordon-named-acs-fellow|title=Teresa Head-Gordon named ACS Fellow {{!}} College of Chemistry|website=chemistry.berkeley.edu | access-date=2018-08-24}}</ref>
